posts.title: Tilak’s knock in vain as Pakistan A beat India A in Asia Cup Rising Stars thriller
posts.description: Tilak Varma’s fighting century (100 off 149 balls) and Shahbaz Ahmed’s 56 could not prevent India A from falling 48 runs short of Pakistan A’s 314-run target. Abhishek Sharma earlier smashed 70 off 42 balls, but Pakistan’s bowlers kept striking at regular intervals. Hasan Nawaz starred with 79 runs and three wickets, while Ali Raza also claimed three scalps.

posts.title: 'Looking in the mirror': Williamson on how Kohli helped him in retirement decision

posts.title: Four wickets in four balls! Debutant creates history, steals the show in SMAT
posts.description: In a thrilling rain-shortened encounter, Vidarbha managed to successfully chase down 129 against Gujarat, showcasing their resilience on the field. Meanwhile, Himachal Pradesh's captain played a pivotal role in their total of 183 runs against Tripura, leading them to victory. Rajasthan dominated Mizoram with a grand score of 224, bolstered by Kunal Singh Rathore's brilliant unbeaten century.
